purpose: Style-independent creature content blueprints. Combine one record with one art/library/styles/*/STYLE.md brief to recreate its illustration.
generationRecipe: Treat the creature record as the only source of identity, anatomy, temperament, equipment, environment, action, pose, and rules-derived visual cues.
Use summary, imageAlt, poseBrief, statistics, and rulesAndAbilitiesMarkdown together; preserve unusually high or low characteristics and visible abilities.
Treat STYLE.md and its anchor as rendering-only references; do not inherit the anchor subject, composition, palette, lighting, weather, or mood.
Keep anatomy coherent and preserve the varied poseBrief rather than defaulting bipedal creatures to one repeated stance.

creatures.title: Ancestor Spirit
creatures.summary: A deceased relative who preserves family memory, craft, and counsel.
creatures.imageAlt: A translucent ancestor spirit holding a woodworking chisel by a hearth.
creatures.poseBrief: Kneeling beneath a cottage loom while demonstrating a treadle repair.
creatures.rulesAndAbilitiesMarkdown: **Helpful Possession:** The Ancestor and a willing Living relative each spend a Combat Action while Close; no Spirit Combat is required. Choose `1D6` appropriate inherited skills when creating it. During possession, the host gains `+1B` with them and normally chooses the shared actions.

creatures.title: Basilisk
creatures.summary: A small, many-coloured reptile created by foul alchemy; its eyes and blood are deadlier than its jaws.
creatures.imageAlt: A brightly colored alchemical basilisk standing on flagstones.
creatures.poseBrief: Creeping sideways from beneath a cracked mortar in an abandoned apothecary.
creatures.rulesAndAbilitiesMarkdown:
**Death Gaze:** Once per turn, freely choose a creature within 16 m that can see the basilisk's eyes. It may avert its gaze, preventing the Gaze; without suitable Blind Sight it then cannot attack or React against the basilisk until its next turn. If it does not avert, oppose the basilisk's Persistence with Resilience. Defeat reduces it to 0 HP and makes it Dying, subject to its type rules; victory grants immunity for this combat. Eye contact must be mutual and Blind Sight never triggers the Gaze. The basilisk may still Bite.

**Basilisk Venom:** **Type:** Injected or contact. **Delay:** Immediate. **Potency:** 65. **Effect:** `-6 CON` for the Duration and `1D4` HP at each minute's end; CON 0 causes death. **Duration:** `6D10` minutes.

**Corrosive Blood:** A mundane weapon that deals HP damage to the basilisk is destroyed after `1D4` rounds. Before the end of the wielder's next turn, a Combat Action with abundant water or a suitable neutraliser prevents this.

creatures.title: Disease Spirit
creatures.summary: A predatory spirit embodying one disease.
creatures.imageAlt: A gaunt yellow-green disease spirit in an empty sickroom.
creatures.poseBrief: Flattening and reforming beneath grain sacks while stalking warmth.
creatures.rulesAndAbilitiesMarkdown: **Disease Possession:** Choose one disease when creating the Spirit. The host chooses shared actions, immediately contracts the disease, and suffers `-1P` on Resilience against disease. A successful recovery test prevents that interval's effect, but the disease remains and tests again after its Delay until the Spirit is expelled. Expulsion permits normal recovery but removes no accumulated effect.

creatures.title: Dog
creatures.summary: A domestic or feral canine that relies on speed and its bite.
creatures.imageAlt: An alert village dog standing on a medieval dirt lane.
creatures.poseBrief: Digging under a tilted farm gate while looking back to listen.
creatures.rulesAndAbilitiesMarkdown: No additional rules or abilities beyond the listed statistics, skills, attacks, talents, and tags.

creatures.title: Dragon
creatures.summary: An ancient, intelligent flying reptile whose magic and temperament vary widely.
creatures.imageAlt: A four-legged, two-winged dragon standing on a rocky upland.
creatures.poseBrief: Descending carefully into a ruined courtyard while lighting one brazier.

statistics.talents: Exceptional Skill (Persistence) III; Exceptional Skill (Influence) II; Exceptional Skill (Resilience) I; Exceptional Skill (Athletics) I; Exceptional Skill (Perception) I; Exceptional Skill (Unarmed Combat) I

creatures.rulesAndAbilitiesMarkdown:
**Double Claw 2 (Multiattack):** Make two Claw attacks. Exceptional Skill (Unarmed Combat) I normally removes the second attack's `-1P`.

**Breathe Flame:** Spend a Combat Action. A 26 m cone, 26 m wide at its end, deals `4D6` fire damage; roll once. An aware target may use its base Reaction to Dodge at `-1P`: success halves damage; failure takes full damage. AP applies. Afterward, another use within one hour requires Resilience, at cumulative `-1P` for each attempt that hour.

**Fire Resistance:** Reduce fire damage by 12 after other reductions.

Ancient dragons may know potent cells such as Conjure·Fire, Bend·Fire, Ward·Fire, or Scry·Fate.

creatures.title: Dryad
creatures.summary: A woodland spirit whose body grows from one tree and whose grove extends 44 m from it.
creatures.imageAlt: A bark-skinned dryad touching her ancient tree while guiding ivy across the grove.
creatures.poseBrief: Standing in a stable three-quarter pose beside her intact anchor tree, one open hand resting flat against its trunk while the other guides two low ribbons of ivy apart across the forest floor; both feet remain distinct and naturally planted, and no limb, staff, or branch merges with the tree.
creatures.rulesAndAbilitiesMarkdown:
**Shaping cells:** Bend·Mind, Alter·Mind, Conjure·Fire, Bend·Paths.

**Grove Anchor:** The Dryad cannot leave its grove; doing so dissolves its body and returns its Spirit to the tree. If the tree is destroyed, it cannot reform.

**Tree Passage:** While touching its tree, spend a Movement Action to dissolve the body or emerge beside the tree.

**One with the Grove:** As a Combat Action, choose one 3 m-radius patch of vegetation in the grove. Until this ability is used again, movement through it costs double, or existing vegetation opens to permit normal movement. The Dryad may instead cause harmless growth, flowers, or fruit. Damage and restraint require Shaping.

creatures.title: Dwarf
creatures.summary: Stocky, long-lived underground folk renowned for craft, mining, and stonework.
creatures.imageAlt: A broad dwarf warrior carrying a hammer and round shield.
creatures.poseBrief: Kneeling in a mine with one palm to stone, using Earth Sense.

attacks: War Hammer or Battleaxe — Close Combat 65%, `1D8 + 0`, Medium

creatures.rulesAndAbilitiesMarkdown:
**Blind Sight (heat):** Thermoception perceives heat-contrasting targets regardless of illumination. Solid barriers, heavy insulation, and ambient-temperature targets defeat it.

**Earth Sense:** While touching connected earth or stone, the dwarf knows approximate depth and whether the surrounding chamber is structurally unstable.

Dwarven Shapers commonly favour Bend, Alter, Ward, or Scry·Earth/Stone cells.

creatures.title: Elemental
creatures.summary: Raw elemental substance embodied as water, darkness, flame, stone, or storm.
creatures.imageAlt: A stone elemental formed from interlocking rock slabs.
creatures.poseBrief: Pulling free from a quarry face, body still half merged with rock.

statistics.derived: Use the rank table; Combat Order 10 is an explicit profile value because Elementals have no DEX or INT
skills: Deception 80% while merged with a substantial quantity of its own element
attacks: Engulf — Attack by rank, rank damage, every other creature within the listed radius
statistics.talents: Small: Exceptional Skill (Dodge) I. Large: Exceptional Skill (Attack) I. Huge: Exceptional Skill (Persistence) I. Medium: none

creatures.rulesAndAbilitiesMarkdown:
| Rank   | SIZ |  HP | MWL |  PP | Move |  CO |  AP | DM  | Damage | Area | Attack | Dodge | Persistence | Resilience |
| ------ | --: | --: | --: | --: | ---: | --: | --: | :-: | -----: | ---: | -----: | ----: | ----------: | ---------: |
| Small  |   3 |   3 |   2 |   0 | 15 m |  10 |   0 |  —  |  `1D6` |  1 m |    15% |  100% |         30% |       100% |
| Medium |   9 |   9 |   5 |   0 | 23 m |  10 |   0 |  —  |  `2D6` |  3 m |    45% |   90% |         60% |       100% |
| Large  |  21 |  21 |  11 |   0 | 30 m |  10 |   0 |  —  |  `3D6` |  7 m |   100% |   60% |         90% |       100% |
| Huge   |  50 |  50 |  25 |   0 | 45 m |  10 |   0 |  —  |  `4D6` | 16 m |      — |   30% |        100% |       100% |

**Engulf:** Spend one Combat Action, centred on the Elemental; complete barriers block it. Roll damage once. Small through Large roll Attack once, which must succeed and win against each target's listed resistance separately.

**Overwhelming Engulf:** Huge rolls no Attack. Critical resistance negates damage, Success takes half, and Failure or Fumble takes full damage.

- **Undine — Drown:** Resilience; HP damage; ignores AP.
- **Shade — Fear:** Persistence; PP damage; ignores AP; normal 0-PP unconsciousness applies.
- **Salamander — Burn:** Resilience; HP damage; AP applies.
- **Gnome — Crush:** Resilience; HP damage; AP applies.
- **Sylph — Buffet:** Resilience; HP damage; AP applies.

**Elemental Nature:** Immune to poison, disease, and its own element.

**Elemental Sense:** Perception 80% detects invisible, Spirit, and magical targets regardless of light or invisibility; a solid barrier blocks it. Ordinary darkness still affects ordinary, nonmagical targets. Oppose concealment with Deception.

**Camouflage:** Deception 80% while merged with matching water, fire, stone, darkness, or cloud.

creatures.title: Elf
creatures.summary: Ageless forest folk bound to their woodland realms and fiercely protective of them.
creatures.imageAlt: A forest elf carrying a longbow and shortspear beside an old tree.
creatures.poseBrief: Crouched sideways on a fallen trunk, drawing a bow through leaves.
creatures.rulesAndAbilitiesMarkdown:
**Exceptional Archer:** Gain `+1B` with bows. The longbow's minimum STR gives this elf `-1P`, so the dice normally cancel.

**Night Sight:** Partial Darkness counts as Illuminated and Darkness as Partial Darkness. Pitch Black and obscurity are unchanged.

Elf Shapers often favour Alter·Flesh, Scry·Flesh, Bend·Earth/Stone, and protective nature cells.

creatures.title: Gargoyle
creatures.summary: A grey, winged humanoid predator often mistaken for a grotesque stone statue.
creatures.imageAlt: A grey winged gargoyle crouching on a cathedral parapet.
creatures.poseBrief: Crawling headfirst down a rain-dark cathedral buttress.
creatures.rulesAndAbilitiesMarkdown: Trained individuals may know a few scouting or warfare Shaping cells.

creatures.title: Ghost
creatures.summary: A dead soul held in the world by obsession, violence, or unfinished duty; it is neither Undead nor Soulless.
creatures.imageAlt: A pale translucent ghost standing in an abandoned timber-framed room.
creatures.poseBrief: Pulling an immaterial ferry rope that vanishes into dry sand.
creatures.rulesAndAbilitiesMarkdown:
**Dominant Possession:** The Ghost normally chooses shared actions. At each turn's start, the host opposes Persistence with the Ghost's Persistence. A host win lets it choose that turn; a Critical win by the host also ends possession.

**Echoes of Life:** A particular Ghost may retain appropriate mundane skills or Shaping cells known while alive.

creatures.title: Ghoul
creatures.summary: An intelligent corpse-eater driven by endless hunger.
creatures.imageAlt: A gaunt grey ghoul with long claws standing in an old burial ground.
creatures.poseBrief: Moving beneath a smokehouse table while twisting into a warning howl.
creatures.rulesAndAbilitiesMarkdown:
**Ghoul Howl:** Freely at the start of its turn, affect every Living listener within 11 m. A howl remains audible until the Ghoul's next turn. Oppose the highest-Persistence audible Ghoul with each listener's Persistence. Defeat gives `-1P` on attacks and Reactions while any howl is audible; victory grants immunity for this combat. A listener tests once per round and multiple howls do not stack. The Ghoul retains its normal actions.

**Ghoul Venom:** **Type:** Injected, ingested, or smeared. **Delay:** `1D3` rounds. **Potency:** 22. **Effect:** Paralysed. **Duration:** `1D10` hours or until healing restores at least 1 HP.

creatures.title: Giant Spider
creatures.summary: A horse-sized ambush predator that traps prey in venomous webs.
creatures.imageAlt: A horse-sized brown spider standing beneath a web in a forest.
creatures.poseBrief: Hanging beneath a ruined roof beam on taut silk lines.

attacks: Web — Unarmed Combat 50%, no damage, Heavy, 15 m

creatures.rulesAndAbilitiesMarkdown:
**Web:** Spend a Combat Action and oppose Unarmed Combat against the Athletics of one target within 15 m. If the spider wins, the target cannot take Movement Actions and suffers `-1P` on physical tests until the web is destroyed. Each web has 22 HP and 0 AP.

**Giant Spider Venom:** A Bite dealing HP damage exposes the target. **Type:** Injected. **Delay:** `1D3` rounds. **Potency:** 51. **Effect:** `-6 DEX` for the Duration and `1D3` HP at each minute's end; DEX 0 causes paralysis. **Duration:** `6D10` minutes.

creatures.title: Giant
creatures.summary: A six-metre humanoid who adopts nearby cultures or lives in an isolated mountain clan.
creatures.imageAlt: A human-faced mountain giant standing beside a huge club and boulder.
creatures.poseBrief: Crouching in a flooded field to lift a stranded wooden cart.

attacks: Thrown Boulder — Ranged Combat 35%, `2D6 + 5D6`, Huge, 49 m

creatures.rulesAndAbilitiesMarkdown: Giants may learn cultural Shaping; isolated ones favour Earth/Stone, Air/Storm, or Spirit cells.

creatures.title: Goblin
creatures.summary: A small, agile humanoid accustomed to surviving through cunning and numbers.
creatures.imageAlt: A small goblin carrying a shortspear and round shield in a hill camp.
creatures.poseBrief: Sliding feet-first beneath a tunnel beam with shield overhead.
creatures.rulesAndAbilitiesMarkdown:
**Blind Sight (heat):** Thermoception perceives heat-contrasting targets regardless of illumination. Solid barriers, heavy insulation, and ambient-temperature targets defeat it.

Leaders and shamans may know combat, trickery, or survival-themed Shaping cells.

creatures.title: Golem
creatures.summary: A clay construct animated to execute a sacred command with literal, tireless precision.
creatures.imageAlt: A heavy clay golem standing motionless in a temple courtyard.
creatures.poseBrief: Lowering a collapsed roof beam while checking a boundary stone.
creatures.rulesAndAbilitiesMarkdown:
**Programmed Task:** A programmed Golem pursues only its stated task and obeys literally. A free-willed Golem is not bound by this rule.

**Construct Body:** It does not breathe, eat, sleep, bleed, or suffer poison or disease. At 0 HP it is disabled or destroyed; 0 PP does not incapacitate it.

**Slow:** It cannot Sprint. Free-willed Golems may learn Shaping.

creatures.title: Griffin
creatures.summary: A proud mountain predator with a lion's body, an eagle's head, and immense wings.
creatures.imageAlt: An eagle-headed griffin with immense wings standing on a mountain meadow.
creatures.poseBrief: Braking asymmetrically just after a raking-dive landing.
creatures.rulesAndAbilitiesMarkdown: **Raking Dive (Multiattack):** Spend the Combat and Movement Actions to fly at least 10 m straight and then make two Claw attacks. This replaces Charge, grants no Charge damage, and retains the base Reaction.

creatures.title: Guardian Spirit
creatures.summary: A bound spirit that protects a place, object, tomb, or treasure according to stated conditions.
creatures.imageAlt: A translucent guardian spirit standing before a sealed tomb door.
creatures.poseBrief: Coiling around a bronze burial mask and howling toward a breached roof.
creatures.rulesAndAbilitiesMarkdown:
**Binding:** Define the anchor and conduct that triggers the Guardian. It cannot move more than 17 m from the anchor.

**Alarm:** When its condition is broken, it howls audibly to 170 m and identifies the intruders. On its next turn it spends its Combat Action to manifest, then acts according to its binding.

creatures.title: Hag
creatures.summary: A cave or darkness spirit that hunts beyond its domain only between sunset and dawn.
creatures.imageAlt: A clawed cave hag standing at the entrance to her rocky domain.
creatures.poseBrief: Crawling crabwise through a cave fissure while shielding light-sensitive eyes.
creatures.rulesAndAbilitiesMarkdown:
**Shaping cells:** Bend·Mind, Alter·Mind, Unmake·Fire, Unmake·Flesh.

**Nightbound:** The Hag may leave its domain only at night. Dawn outside the domain or direct natural sunlight destroys its body and returns its Spirit home.

**Create Shade:** In Darkness within its domain, spend a Combat Action and 3 PP to create one Small Shade using the Elemental profile. Give it one simple standing order; it follows literally and otherwise protects the Hag. Changing the order costs the Hag a Combat Action. It acts immediately after the Hag and remains within the domain until destroyed or dismissed. Only one may exist at a time.

creatures.title: Harpy
creatures.summary: A filthy, winged scavenger whose claws and missiles spread disease.
creatures.imageAlt: A winged harpy holding a stone on a bare cliff ledge.
creatures.poseBrief: Banking over a coastal cliff with a filthy dropped missile.

attacks: Dropped Stone — Ranged Combat 40%, `1D6` per full 3 m fallen, maximum `10D6`, Light, directly below
Dung — Ranged Combat 40%, no damage, Light, directly below

creatures.rulesAndAbilitiesMarkdown:
**Dropped Missile:** Choose a target directly below the Harpy, no more than 30 m down. Dropping a stone or dung is a Ranged Combat attack; an aware target may React normally.

**Filth:** A damaging Claw, dung hit, or dung-coated stone exposes the victim to the Shakes. **Type:** Touch. **Delay:** `1D2` days. **Potency:** 50. **Effect:** DEX remains halved while active; lose `1D6` HP after each Delay. **Duration:** Until the victim wins a repeated Resilience-versus-Potency test.

**Stench:** A dung hit gives `-1P` to Influence and Deception until the victim and equipment are washed for one hour. Harpies are immune to disease. Some know Bend·Force/Motion or Alter·Flesh.

creatures.title: Hawk
creatures.summary: A small, agile bird of prey.
creatures.imageAlt: A hawk perched on a weathered branch above open countryside.
creatures.poseBrief: Banking through tall meadow grass with talons opening.

creatures.title: Healing Spirit
creatures.summary: A luminous restorative spirit and natural enemy of Disease Spirits.
creatures.imageAlt: A pale healing spirit with open hands in an herb garden.
creatures.poseBrief: Heron-like spirit spearing a patch of fever vapor in an herb garden.
creatures.rulesAndAbilitiesMarkdown:
**Shaping cells:** Alter·Flesh, Scry·Flesh.

**Disease Hunter:** It may initiate Spirit Combat with a Disease Spirit possessing a creature it touches. The host suffers no PP damage from that combat. Banishment ends the disease possession. A Healing Spirit cannot possess.

creatures.title: Holy Steed
creatures.summary: A deity's otherworldly mount, manifesting as a sacred eagle, kraken, iron horse, or similar form.
creatures.imageAlt: A sacred horse formed from dark iron plates in a temple court.
creatures.poseBrief: Testing a broken stone bridge with deliberate, intelligent balance.

attacks: Fist or Kick — Unarmed Combat 80%, `1D10 + 2D6`, Light
statistics.talents: Exceptional Skill (Dodge) I; Exceptional Skill (Persistence) I; Exceptional Skill (Resilience) I

creatures.rulesAndAbilitiesMarkdown: **Divine Form:** Choose land, swim, or flight as its 20 m movement mode when creating it.

creatures.title: Holy Warrior
creatures.summary: An otherworldly champion whose form and weapon reflect its deity.
creatures.imageAlt: A holy warrior carrying a longspear and round shield.
creatures.poseBrief: Striding down broken sanctuary steps in full silver-and-gold plate, round shield raised in a natural forward guard and longspear angled back; calm commanding face framed by a disciplined golden-white dawn halo and radiant aura, with cobalt tabard and vermilion cloak lifted by a sacred wind.

skills: choose Close Combat, Ranged Combat, or Unarmed Combat 100%
statistics.talents: Exceptional Skill (Dodge) II; Exceptional Skill (chosen combat skill) II; Exceptional Skill (Resilience) I; Exceptional Skill (Athletics) I

creatures.rulesAndAbilitiesMarkdown: Appearance, weapon, and optional Shaping cells express its patron without changing these values.

creatures.title: Magic Spirit
creatures.summary: A constellation of coloured lights gathered around one coherent magical theme.
creatures.imageAlt: A blue-violet constellation spirit floating above a hilltop.
creatures.poseBrief: Folding a constellation-like body through an overturned astrolabe.
creatures.rulesAndAbilitiesMarkdown:
**Shaping Cells:** Choose `1D6` cells sharing one Form or coherent theme. Shaping is `POW × 5`%, capped at 100%. The Spirit casts and spends its own PP; it cannot lend PP, active capacity, or cells.

**Defensive Spirit:** It cannot initiate Spirit Combat but may defend when another creature initiates it.

creatures.title: Merfolk
creatures.summary: A territorial sea-dweller whose undersea society mirrors kingdoms above.
creatures.imageAlt: A merfolk guard carrying a longspear above an undersea terrace.
creatures.poseBrief: Rolling under a fallen mast using spear and tail as a pivot.
creatures.rulesAndAbilitiesMarkdown: **Aquatic:** Breathes air and can hold its breath underwater for 11 minutes. Merfolk Shapers commonly know Water/Ice cells.

creatures.title: Mummy
creatures.summary: An intelligent, ritually preserved ruler or guardian with no Shaping by default.
creatures.imageAlt: A bandaged mummy holding a great hammer in a dry stone burial chamber.
creatures.poseBrief: Descending a burial stair seated, one rigid step at a time.
creatures.rulesAndAbilitiesMarkdown:
**Flammable:** Fire that deals HP damage ignites the Mummy. At each round's end it suffers that damage again without reapplying AP. Extinguishing costs its Combat Action, Movement Action, and all Reactions while it rolls, smothers the flames, or enters water.

**Preserved Flesh:** Alter·Flesh repairs it at normal Intensity. Mind affects it normally; Soulless protects only against Spirit.

creatures.title: Naiad
creatures.summary: A water spirit anchored to one stream, lake, swamp, or coastal reach.
creatures.imageAlt: A blue-grey naiad holding a spear in the shallow stream she guards.
creatures.poseBrief: Swinging horizontally around a planted spear through fast current.
creatures.rulesAndAbilitiesMarkdown:
**Shaping cells:** Bend·Water/Ice, Alter·Water/Ice, Ward·Water/Ice, Alter·Flesh, Bend·Mind.

**Water Anchor:** Each complete 10 m band travelled away from its water costs 1 PP; returning restores none. The Naiad recovers PP only while submerged. At 0 PP, its body collapses into water and its Spirit returns home.

**Undine Transformation:** Spend a Combat Action and 9 PP to adopt a Medium Undine shell under the shared rule. A Combat Action restores normal form.

creatures.title: Ogre
creatures.summary: A massive, warty humanoid who dominates weaker creatures through brute force.
creatures.imageAlt: A broad-shouldered grey-green ogre standing on an old stone bridge.
creatures.poseBrief: Hauling a great axe free from a shattered stump in a rocky ravine.

attacks: Improvised Rock — Ranged Combat 40%, `1D4 + 2D6`, Light, 23 m

creatures.rulesAndAbilitiesMarkdown: Ogre mystics commonly favour destructive Fire, Flesh, Mind, or Spirit cells.

creatures.title: Orc
creatures.summary: A violent clan-based humanoid whose warband is ruled by strength and ambition.
creatures.imageAlt: An orc fighter advancing through ruined streets behind a round shield.
creatures.poseBrief: Vaulting sideways through a ruined window with shield leading.
creatures.rulesAndAbilitiesMarkdown: War leaders and shamans may know aggressive or protective Shaping cells.

creatures.title: Oread
creatures.summary: A stone spirit anchored to one hill, mountain, valley, or similar landform.
creatures.imageAlt: A stone-skinned oread holding a rock on a mountain slope.
creatures.poseBrief: Skating down steep scree on a slab while catching a falling stone.

attacks: Thrown Rock — Ranged Combat 40%, `1D4 + 0`, Light, 7 m

creatures.rulesAndAbilitiesMarkdown:
**Shaping cells:** Bend·Earth/Stone, Alter·Earth/Stone, Ward·Earth/Stone, Unmake·Earth/Stone, Scry·Earth/Stone.

**Earth Anchor:** Each complete 10 m band travelled away from its domain costs 1 PP; returning restores none. The Oread recovers PP only within its domain. At 0 PP, its body petrifies and its Spirit returns home.

**Gnome Transformation:** Spend a Combat Action and 9 PP to adopt a Medium Gnome shell under the shared rule. A Combat Action restores normal form.

creatures.title: Passion Spirit
creatures.summary: A predatory embodiment of fear, madness, or pain; choose one passion when creating it.
creatures.imageAlt: A violet fear spirit reaching through an empty stone passage.
creatures.poseBrief: Spiraling around a swinging watchtower door as embodied fear.
creatures.rulesAndAbilitiesMarkdown:
The host chooses shared actions except when Madness incapacitates it.

**Fear Possession:** The host suffers `-1P` on attacks and Reactions.

**Pain Possession:** The host suffers `-1P` on every skill test.

**Madness Possession:** At each stressful scene's start, oppose the Spirit's Persistence with the host's Resilience. If the Spirit wins, the host is Incapacitated—no Actions or Reactions—for `1D6 × 10` minutes. A host win prevents another fit that scene.

creatures.title: Pixie
creatures.summary: A tiny, winged forest person known for curiosity, mischief, and subtle magic.
creatures.imageAlt: A tiny winged pixie standing on a broad shelf mushroom.
creatures.poseBrief: Standing upright after a light landing on a broad shelf mushroom, head, torso, hips, and feet aligned in one natural three-quarter direction; exactly four translucent wings attach symmetrically behind the shoulder blades with leading edges and tips extending outward, upward, and backward, while one open hand guides a subtle breeze around a luminous seed.
creatures.rulesAndAbilitiesMarkdown: Magical Pixies may know cells such as Conjure·Mind, Bend·Air/Storm, or Bend·Paths; set Shaping to suit the individual.

creatures.title: Raven
creatures.summary: A quick and observant scavenging bird.
creatures.imageAlt: A black raven perched on a mossy stone wall.
creatures.poseBrief: Hopping sideways on a fence rail while snatching a beetle.
creatures.rulesAndAbilitiesMarkdown: No additional rules or abilities beyond the listed statistics, skills, attacks, talents, and tags.

creatures.title: Rhinoceros
creatures.summary: A thick-skinned herbivore whose charge can tear through a battle line.
creatures.imageAlt: A two-horned rhinoceros standing on open scrubland.
creatures.poseBrief: Braking and swinging its mass after a missed charge.
creatures.rulesAndAbilitiesMarkdown: **Horn Charge:** Use Gore for a normal Charge attack and add the Charge's `+1D6` damage.

creatures.title: Sea Serpent
creatures.summary: An enormous aquatic serpent that drags prey to caverns beneath the sea.
creatures.imageAlt: A huge finned sea serpent swimming near an underwater cavern.
creatures.poseBrief: Turning slowly around a sea stack, body split above and below water.
creatures.rulesAndAbilitiesMarkdown: **Aquatic:** Breathes water and cannot move under its own power on land.

creatures.title: Skeleton
creatures.summary: Animated bones following simple commands.
creatures.imageAlt: An animated skeleton carrying an arming sword and round wooden shield.
creatures.poseBrief: Descending a broken staircase backward on hands and feet.
creatures.rulesAndAbilitiesMarkdown: **Pierce Resistance:** After Parry and AP, halve damage from piercing weapons.

creatures.title: Troll
creatures.summary: A large, solitary predator whose body repairs wounds with terrifying speed.
creatures.imageAlt: A long-armed troll carrying a wooden club in a rocky ravine.
creatures.poseBrief: Crawling awkwardly beneath a fallen trunk while a wound closes.
creatures.rulesAndAbilitiesMarkdown:
**Regeneration:** At the start of its turn, even at 0 HP, recover `1D6` HP unless it has taken fire damage since the start of its previous turn. This bypasses Wounded's recovery lock and removes Bleeding and Dying; Wounded remains. If HP rises above 0, the Troll wakes and may act that turn.

**Blind Sight (heat):** Thermoception perceives heat-contrasting targets regardless of illumination. Solid barriers, heavy insulation, and ambient-temperature targets defeat it.

creatures.title: Vampire
creatures.summary: An intelligent undead predator sustained by stolen blood and life force.
creatures.imageAlt: A pale armored vampire carrying a sword and round shield in a stone hall.
creatures.poseBrief: Turning its lower body to mist while levering a locked inn latch.
creatures.rulesAndAbilitiesMarkdown:
**Senses:** Night Vision; Blind Sight (living beings), blocked by walls and complete solid cover.

**Blood Reserve:** Maximum 18, current 0. Use current Reserve as PP and maximum Reserve instead of POW for the active Shaping limit. It pays costs, Counter, rituals, and commitments, but never recovers naturally; 0 does not incapacitate the Vampire. It also recovers no HP naturally.

**Clinging Bite:** If Bite deals HP damage, establish a grapple with that target without another Action or test.

**Drain:** While grappling a Living target, spend a Combat Action and roll `1D6`. If the target began above 0 PP, drain actual PP up to its current PP; only if it began at 0 PP, drain HP instead. Drain ignores AP and never spills from PP to HP. Allocate the actual amount between Vampire HP and Blood Reserve within their maxima; excess is lost.

**Mist Form:** Spend a Combat Action to become mist with carried nonliving equipment. It is immune to mundane physical attacks and can only use its Movement Action or a Combat Action to reform. Magic and sunlight work normally.

**Death Mist:** At 0 HP, the Vampire is disabled until the start of its next turn, then enters Mist Form at 1 HP. Before then, an adjacent creature can spend a full round to stake and decapitate it, destroying it permanently.

**Sunlight:** Direct natural sunlight deals 2 HP at each round's end, ignoring AP; complete opaque covering prevents exposure.

**Holy Aversion:** Choose a sacred symbol. Presenting it within sight spends a Combat Action and opposes the bearer's Persistence with the Vampire's Resilience. If the bearer wins, the Vampire loses `1D4` HP ignoring AP and cannot attack the bearer until the bearer's next turn while the symbol remains visible.

Individual Vampires may learn Shaping cells and pay for them from Blood Reserve.

creatures.title: Viper
creatures.summary: A fast venomous snake whose bite can bring down much larger prey.
creatures.imageAlt: A patterned viper resting in a compact coil on a rock.
creatures.poseBrief: Flowing through a grounded S-turn between sunlit stones.
creatures.rulesAndAbilitiesMarkdown: **Viper Venom:** A Bite dealing HP damage exposes the target. **Type:** Injected. **Delay:** 1 round. **Potency:** 48. **Effect:** `-3 CON` for the Duration and `1D4` HP at each minute's end; CON 0 causes death. **Duration:** `6D10` minutes.

creatures.title: Werewolf
creatures.summary: A person who can become a giant wolf willingly—or involuntarily beneath the full moon.
creatures.imageAlt: A werewolf in giant-wolf form standing beside a discarded cloak.
creatures.poseBrief: Twisting low mid-transformation while pulling at an ankle chain.

attacks: Human Arming Sword — Close Combat 35%, `1D8 + 0`, Medium

creatures.rulesAndAbilitiesMarkdown:
**Shapeshift:** Spend a Combat Action on two consecutive turns; transformation completes after the second. A full moon forces wolf form.

**Night Vision:** In either form, natural surface night counts as Illuminated. It does not overcome sealed, underground, or supernatural darkness or obscurity.

**Wolf Immunity:** In wolf form, mundane attacks deal no damage unless silver, fire, or magical; a qualifying source deals normal damage. Poison, suffocation, and drowning still work. Mystics favour Alter·Flesh, Scry·Flesh, or Earth/Stone cells.

creatures.title: Wolf
creatures.summary: A swift pack predator armed with powerful jaws and claws.
creatures.imageAlt: A grey wolf standing alert in a forest clearing.
creatures.poseBrief: Pausing mid-trot in snow to listen toward an off-frame pack.
creatures.rulesAndAbilitiesMarkdown: No additional rules or abilities beyond the listed statistics, skills, attacks, talents, and tags.

creatures.title: Wyvern
creatures.summary: A lean, two-legged draconic predator armed with jaws, claws, and a venomous tail.
creatures.imageAlt: A two-legged winged wyvern standing on a rocky mountain shelf.
creatures.poseBrief: Climbing an escarpment with two hind legs and wing-wrists.
creatures.rulesAndAbilitiesMarkdown:
**Bite/Claw/Sting 3 (Multiattack):** Make all three attacks; Bite is normal, while Claw and Sting each suffer `-1P` under Multiattack.

**Wyvern Venom:** **Type:** Injected. **Delay:** `1D2` rounds. **Potency:** 60. **Effect:** `1D6` HP and `-4 CON`. **Duration:** `6D10` minutes.

creatures.title: Zombie
creatures.summary: A rotting corpse animated to obey simple commands or attack the living.
creatures.imageAlt: A grey-green zombie standing slackly on an abandoned farm lane.
creatures.poseBrief: Crawling belly-down up a loose grain slope without coordination.
